Infrastructure Administrator  
 
 
 
 
COMPANY : SASFIN BANK LTD  
DIVISION : Information Technology 
JOB TITLE : Infrastructure Administrator 
MANAGER : Infrastructure Manager 
LOCATION :  Waverley, Johannesburg 
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB 
 
The Infrastructure Administrator is responsible for ensuring that the performance and availability of the server and 
network infrastructure is maintained to the highest standard with maximum levels of productivity and efficiency. They are 
responsible for ongoing administration and support of all Infrastructure systems. 
 
Administrators are responsible for  
•  advising systematic know how of procedures, operat ions and work instructions 
•  checking systems and equipment for substandard per formance or malfunctioning 
•  fixing systems and equipment problems 
•  identifying performance problems and malfunctions 
•  maintaining hardware and corresponding documentati on of fixes, notes and recommendations 
•  performing hardware checks using appropriate testi ng and benchmarking tools 
•  daily infrastructure checks and reports 
 
Infrastructure deals with 
•  Communications and connectivity  :- , Network configuration, Network devices and equipment, Network 
infrastructure preparation, Network management tools, Network monitoring ( traffic, transmission quality, etc...), 
Network security, encryption and PKI, Network support, Phone, satellite, wireless and cables, Switch 
technologies and PBX’s, Telecommunications policy and standards, Backup and restore techniques, Logistics 
setup and maintenance,  Performance monitoring and tools, Service level agreements, Systematic and routine 
tasks, Updating live systems 
•  Enterprise security design :- Firewalls (hardware/software), Information security, Internet security, Securing 
different networks and connectivity types, Security for applications, databases and websites, Security for 
control and accessibility equipment, Security infrastructure, Security standards and protocols, Security tools, 
Server security, Security auditing 
 
An Infrastructure Administrator must have the ability to work on: 
•  Communications and connectivity 
•  Internet technologies, IP technologies 
•  Network devices and equipment 
•  Network management tools 
•  Networking design and diagrams 
•  Networking standards and protocols 
•  Routers, switches, hubs, and firewalls 
•  Wired, wireless, and satellite networks 
•  Windows Server Operating systems 
•  Systems Centre Products 
•  Microsoft Exchange 
•  Hyper V Hosts 
•  SAN Storage 
•  SQL Administration and monitoring 
 
KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY 
 
1. Monitoring 
a. Maintain monitoring and management platforms  
b. Monitoring network usage;  gathering monitoring statistics 
c. Managing routine preventative procedures and mai ntaining and monitoring network security 
d. Proactively manage the monitoring and reporting o f infrastructure capacity including bandwidth, 
storage etc. 
e. Provide capacity usage information to facilitate capacity planning 
 
 
 
 
2. Analysis 
a. Analysing and resolving faults,  
b. Ensuring that all IT equipment complies with indu stry standards;  
c. Monitoring network environments. 
d. Updating process, procedure. 
 
3. Installation and configuration (Maintenance and New Requirements) 
a. Administering  IT developments and undertaking pr oject work, 
b. Proactively maintain infrastructure to prevent fa ilures  
c. Maintenance of development and testing network e nvironments 
d. Supporting and maintaining new server hardware an d software infrastructure;  
e. Setting up of user accounts, permissions and pass words to ensure compliance with policy 
 
4. Technical Support 
a. Provide infrastructure tier 1 support 
b. Escalate to infrastructure tier 2 support (Infras tructure Engineers) or 3 rd  party when required 
c. Providing training and technical support for Infr astructure Administrators 
 
5. Operations 
a. Compile daily operational reporting for review b y management team 
b. Provide operational backup to other Infrastructur e Administrator in their absence 
 
DESCRIPTION OF TASKS 
 
1. Service Management 
a. Administer and support server and network infrast ructure 
b. Log and follow-up issues with Vendors 
c. Monitor and analyse system trends in the operati onal environment 
d. Perform health system checks on areas of responsi bility 
 
2. IT Procedures 
a. Ensure systems adhere to OLAs and SLAs 
b. Ensure projects, tasks and operations follow comp any and departmental policies and procedures 
 
3. Feedback and activity updates to: 
a. Line Manager : this role reports to Infrastructu re Manager 
b. Team Lead : this role feeds back to Infrastructu re Team Lead 
c. Service Manager : this role provides daily operat ional reporting to the Service Manager 
d. Infrastructure Engineers – this role is required  to do shift handover to other engineers. 
SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED 
 
1. Business / Industry Experience 
a. Experienced in banking, stockbroking, transactio nal finance, 
  
2. Education 
a. Matric plus an appropriate tertiary qualificatio n (NQF5 or above) with 1 years relevant experience in 
Infrastructure OR Matric with 2 years relevant experience in Infrastructure  
b. Microsoft Certified IT Professional (MCITP): Enterp rise Administrator 
c. HP Accredited Systems Engineer (ASE) 
d. Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) 
e. Cisco Certified Network Associate: Voice (CCNA: Voi ce) 
 
3. Experience 
a. Minimum 2 years’ experience in maintaining Micro soft network in a medium to large scale environment 
b. Experience in a high-availability, online transa cting environment. 
c. Thorough understanding of Microsoft Windows Serve r System technologies 
 
4. Technology 
a. Experience managing Cisco network devices. 
b. Experience with Hewlett Packard server and storag e technologies. 
 
 
c. Experience with multiple storage and backup subs ystems. 
d. Experience with Cisco IP Telephony. 
 
5. Methodology 
a. Exposure to Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF)  with preference to attendance of course 1737 - MOF 
Essentials 
b. ITIL Foundations Certificate 
 
PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES 
 
•  Working  Style 
o Teamwork and cross collaboration ability 
o Mind-set that understands the critical importance of service availability, recoverability, maintainability and 
scalability. 
o Prepared to meet measurable targets for uptime and performance 
o Prepared to work after hours, shifts and be on stan dby on a scheduled basis. 
 
•  Communication skills 
o Ability to conduct technical planning sessions 
o Ability to feedback on technical issues in a struct ured manner 
 
•  Time Management 
o Solid work ethic with attention to detail 
o Ability to work under pressure 
 
•  Conformance 
o Strong process background in change control, backup  strategies and disaster recovery 
o Ability to adhere to very strict policies and proce dures 
o Focus on planning, testing and carefully controlle d implementations 
 
   REMUNERATION 
 
Total Cost to Company, market related depending on qualification and experience. 
Interested applicants can forward their CV to sasfinrecruitment@sasfin.com  by no later than: 12 July 2016.
